body: Correction to my prior handoff: hold proposal of 60d1827. Exact source re-read found a content blocker. Media rights and coder-annotation rights are merged despite the plan/ADR requiring per-component rights, and one Derivation receipt state merges the independent TSV, CSV, and alias-mapping receipts. Please amend the same two paths so mixed states are representable, add the stated intermediate-state court, create a distinct successor with sole parent e584ad6 without moving shared main, and propose only that successor. Full blocker is on the bead.
